provenance.stage: paired HHM Fig. 8 chemical-potential policy audit
provenance.paper: Hutchinson, Hirsch, Marsiglio, arXiv:1801.08988, Fig. 8 parameter set
provenance.strict_band: analytic square-lattice Rashba band; edge tolerance 1e-8 t
provenance.paper_Tc_method: linearized HHM determinant plus normal-state number equation
provenance.repository_Tc_method: nonlinear gap bisection where Deff(T)=0.01 Deff(0); not the HHM Tc criterion

parameter.note: policy-discrimination control; not an HHM Fig. 8 point

provenance.caveat: Matching the Fig. 8 parameter set cannot distinguish strict from relaxed when every accepted root is in-band. It also cannot establish free-energy ordering or exact digitized curve agreement.
